text:
elaine: uploaded a quick prototype for the pin modal + filter reorder we discussed. PTAL — main concerns: badge density in narrow table, unclear pin copy, and filter order reset after pin. https://f.link/proto :eyes:
omar: looked great, +1 on the density issue. question: should pin be per-model-version or per-row? feels blurry when you open the modal
kai: suggestion — separate 'Pin to compare' (temporary) vs 'Pin version' (persisted) in the modal with a small info tooltip. copy: 'Pin for this session' vs 'Pin this version'
maddy: dev perspective: adding two states is fine, but the table currently assumes a single pinned id per row. we can add a session-only pin in stateful client, but need backend flag if we want persistence across devices
sanjay: accessibility nits: modal title needs an aria-label that includes context (e.g., "Pin model version — ModelName v2"), and the badge icons need accessible names, not just color. Also keyboard flow should skip the long badge list when using screen reader
priya: copy tweaks: current button label 'Pin' is ambiguous. try 'Pin version' (primary) and 'Pin for session' (secondary). tooltip: 'Keeps this version at the top of compare for this session'
ryan: on small widths badges collapse into a single overflow chip. suggestion: show most important badge + "+N" overflow, and move performance badges to a right aligned compact column so they don't push copy to 2 lines
kai: re: filter ordering — when a version is pinned we should bake that into the filter state (e.g., filters keep 'Pinned' at top). right now pinning clears the active sort which is confusing
elaine: proposal: pin modal changes: 1) two radio options (session vs persistent) 2) compact badge layout inside modal 3) inline microcopy under buttons. I added this as an overlay in the proto
omar: decision needed: do we ship session-only first (fast) or persistent-first (backend work). my preference: session-first so UX unblock, then persistent in next sprint
maddy: agree session-first. I'll scope a lightweight client-only implementation: store pinned ids in localStorage + route-level param for shareability. we can add API later for cross-device sync
sanjay: small keyboard test request: ensure pressing 'p' while focus on a row triggers pin shortcut, but only after adding a visible focus ring on the row. without that keyboard users will get lost
priya: microcopy suggestion for empty state in compare when pinned model mismatch: "No pinned versions match this filter. Unpin or adjust filters to see pinned items." shorter alt: "Pinned version hidden by filters"
ryan: CSS note — when we add overflow chip, avoid relying on :hover for tooltip (touch friendly). use explicit tap/click to open small popover
figma-bot: Updated file: https://f.link/proto#v2 — frames 12-14 demonstrate the modal states
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll update the figma with Kai's tooltip copy and Priya's empty-state text, then hand off to Maddy for session-first implementation. tagging @maddy for scope
maddy: got it, assigning a ticket and will post a quick RFC with implementation details tomorrow :thumbsup:
omar: TL;DR: ship session-only pin + compact badge overflow in narrow tables. follow-up: product/eng sync Weds to lock copy and accessibility checklist
elaine: cool — will add follow-up note in the design doc and include acceptance criteria (keyboard shortcut, screen-reader labels, overflow behavior). thanks all :sparkles:
